name: White River — Beaver Lake Dam Site Boat Ramp to Houseman Boat Ramp
blurb: White River in Arkansas: sections between public Arkansas Game and Fish Commission accesses.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.putIn: Beaver Lake Dam Site Boat Ramp
sections.notes: Put-in Beaver Lake Dam Site Boat Ramp: exact agency access pin. Take-out Bertrand Boat Ramp: exact agency access pin. Cold tailwater below Beaver Dam. Hydroelectric and flood-control releases change river flow; check current releases and the observed river level before launching. Arkansas law: no glass containers in canoes, kayaks or tubes; keep food and drink in sealed containers, carry a closable trash bag affixed to the boat and use floating drink holders; children 12 and under wear life jackets. Banks and gravel bars beside private land may be private — use public accesses. Mileage: preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry (no agency mileage found).

notices.title: Dam-controlled tailwater
notices.text: This reach is below Beaver Dam. Cold water and changing releases affect the float; check current dam operations and river conditions. A dotted course shows river bends, not safe depth, a rapid line or an exact landing connection.
notices.sourceName: Arkansas Game and Fish Commission — tailwater information

Individual imagery places the unchanged agency coordinate in the water beside the visible ramp, so the marker now uses approximate Area precision. The stable access ID and numeric position are preserved. No surveyed landing point or bank-side claim is made.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the signed AGFC Houseman access and its concrete boat ramp. The Area marker locates the facility vicinity; identify the ramp and check current river level during your shuttle. It is not a precise water-entry or exit point.
